newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end slightly up on technical rebound.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end slightly up on technical rebound.

text.p: Brazilian shares erased early losses to end up 0.59 percent on a technical rebound, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most traded shares ended up 519 points at 88,287 points. Turnover was moderate at 516.5 million reais ($491.4 million).
"It is a technical correction. Prices had fallen too much in the last couple of days," said Marcio Bressan from Senso brokerage.
